name: GIMP Native
tagline: Launch GIMP from the Home Screen
seoTitle: GIMP in an iPadOS app window (jailbreak) · xiOS
seoDescription: Launch the full desktop GIMP locally from the iPad Home Screen in an individual xiOS host window. Requires a compatible rootless jailbreak.
description:
**GIMP Native** adds a Home Screen launcher and its own xiOS host window for the `gimp` package.

GIMP still runs locally as the same arm64 GTK3 build; this package supplies the launcher and the host integration. It requires a compatible rootless jailbreak and installs the main GIMP package as a dependency.
